references.text: Warns against the fire of hell
Better to enter life lame or with one eye than to have two hands or two eyes and be thrown into eternal fire
It is better to enter life lame than to have two feet and be thrown into hell
Those who worship the beast will also drink from God's wine of wrath and be tormented with fire and sulfur
The devil, the beast, and the false prophet are thrown into the lake of fire; Death and Hades are thrown into the lake of fire
The cowardly, unbelieving, detestable, murderers, sexually immoral, sorcerers, idolaters, and all liars will have their part in the lake that burns with fire and sulfur
